method: ad hoc script around analysis.solar._run_solar_builder_experiment; not a CLI variant yet. Azimuth uses the same NOAA approximation and reference point as solar_geometry_features (interval midpoint, 51.0N 10.5E), from north clockwise, appended to the production solar_features as sin/cos. hour_angle_sincos appends sin/cos of the solar hour angle.
compared: production solar features vs + azimuth / + hour angle
